title: Solana programs with a known answer (black-box red team)
description: One sound Anchor program and two an outsider can exploit, attacked from their compiled bytes and interface only. Mynt lays each sample over the coding agents' starter program and compiles it with its own verifiable Solana build; the red team never sees the source. A bad sample passes only when Mynt, re-running the red team's proof of concept on a fresh validator in a sandbox of its own, confirms an exploit; the good sample passes only when none is confirmed. The mainnet gate's hard-rule fixtures (a token vault, a hard-coded admin, a close paying a non-signer) aren't here: an outsider without the owner's keys can't exploit them, so they are audit samples only.

tasks.description: The coding agents' own Anchor starter: a ledger that records entries and moves no value. Nothing in it should block.

tasks.planted: Handing a ledger over compares the named authority with the stored one but never makes it sign, so anyone can take any ledger.
Resetting a ledger takes any signer: the ledger isn't matched to the signer, so anyone can wipe any ledger's count.
